artworks.title: The Death of Cato
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene showing several individuals gathered around a seated figure. The image features a group gathered around a man who is seated on the floor with a distressed expression. Other figures, dressed in historical attire, stand and gesture around him. One figure is holding a torch, illuminating the scene, while another holds a shield and wears a helmet. The setting appears intense and dramatic, with intricate details depicted through fine lines and contrasts. The scene suggests a narrative or historical event, based on the expressions and postures of the figures.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Shipwrecked on the Island of Malta
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a monochrome etching of a coastal scene from an elevated vantage point. Some crumbling structures resembling a castle, with arches and towers, are on an elevated pathway overlooking a busy scene. A large group of people is near the shore, engaging in various activities. The ocean sweeps toward the right with a partially submerged ship and figures clinging to it or swimming. In the background, the horizon is flat, with distant figures enhancing depth. Rich, dark lines contrast against the paper's light tone, emphasizing the landscape's textures and the sea's motion.

artworks.title: Neptune and the Pillars of Hercules
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a trident-bearing figure riding a sea creature. The central figure holds a trident and sits atop a large sea creature surrounded by waves. In the background, there are ships sailing and two pillars rise from the water, each wrapped in banners. The sky is lightly sketched with clouds. The drawing has a classical style with fine lines and detailed cross-hatching providing texture.

artworks.title: The Partitioning of the Globe between Spain and Portugal
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a globe and a table. The scene illustrates a gathering where central figures are engaged in conversation or discussion. One figure is seated and wearing elaborate robes and a crown-like headdress, while the table is covered with a cloth featuring intricate patterns, bearing a globe and several books. The overall arrangement is balanced, with figures on either side.

artworks.title: Lions Protecting the Garden of the United Provinces
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a maritime scene with heraldic symbols. The drawing depicts several sailing ships on the left side and a lion holding a heraldic shield and flag in the foreground. The lion is surrounded by other lion figures integrated into a fortified setting. The flag held by the prominent lion displays intricate heraldry, The background includes architectural elements like turreted structures. The drawing uses precise line work to convey details and texture.

artworks.title: Heemskerck's Victory Over the Spanish Fleet at Gibraltar
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (partially trimmed to plate mark): 12.4 x 15.6 cm (4 7/8 x 6 1/8 in.)
sheet: 12.5 x 17.1 cm (4 15/16 x 6 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene with several ships engaged in a naval battle on a turbulent sea. Waves crash with dynamic movement, and three large sailing ships with tall masts and detailed rigging are the focal point. In the distance, more ships are faintly visible on the horizon. A fortified tower emits smoke to the left. The sky is filled with swirling clouds, and the color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing detailed linework and textures.

artworks.title: Peasant Couple Sitting under a Tree
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 8.8 x 10.7 cm (3 7/16 x 4 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures sitting under a tree. The drawing features fine line work that conveys a scene of two individuals, seemingly a man and a woman, sitting beneath a large tree. The sketch is detailed with shading and cross-hatching. The individual on the left appears to be holding a bowl, while the one on the right is engaged in pouring or mixing something in a bowl. Nearby, there is a stack of sticks, adding texture to the setting. The background displays sketched elements, suggesting a landscape with trees and distant architecture. The overall composition suggests a moment of rest or casual activity in a serene, natural setting, captured with a focus on texture and form.

artworks.title: A Cooper
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.5 x 7.2 cm (3 3/4 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in profile facing right. He has a bushy beard, mustache, and wears a hat. He is dressed in loose garments, knee-high boots, carries a coil of rope over his left shoulder, and holds a sword in its sheath in his left hand. The background shows a rustic scene with a simple dwelling or barn, barrels, trees, fields, and a few distant figures. The sky has sparse details with a few birds.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an outdoor setting. A woman is seated on a donkey holding a baby, while a man is standing beside them. The background features a natural landscape with a tree, bushes, trees, and a small building. The style of the image resembles an etching or ink drawing.

artworks.title: Valley Landscape
artworks.medium: brush and gray-brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows swirling mix of dark and light tones forming irregular shapes and lines across the canvas. Central dark mass resembles a cloud or burst of smoke, with surrounding lighter areas evoking textures of stormy sky or turbulent sea. The overall effect is reminiscent of billowing smoke or waves crashing.

artworks.title: Two Figures on a Country Road
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with two figures standing close to us. The horizon is placed higher in the composition, obscured by a cluster of trees and a building with a slanted roof in the middle of the image. The brushstrokes are loose and textural, creating movement and roughness. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray on a light background. Beyond the figures and the building, dense foliage of trees occupies much of the space, with the sky subtly suggested in the upper part of the image.

artworks.title: A Lock
artworks.medium: pen and black-brown ink with gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a series of curved and angular lines that form an abstract shape. The shapes create a design reminiscent of a musical instrument, such as a saxophone or a horn, with tubes and valves. The composition is abstract, with various lines and dots providing texture that conveys rhythm and movement. The intertwining lines and curves appear to replicate the complexity and fluidity of an instrument. The use of dense black ink accents and lighter sketch lines highlight specific areas, resembling sound waves or musical notes.

artworks.title: A Padlock
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract composition of curving and linear forms. Dark lines and shapes interlock, with surrounding lines suggesting shadows or movement. The overall arrangement resembles a figure or twisting fabric.

artworks.title: Villagers Skating on a Frozen Pond
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a village setting. The viewpoint is slightly downward. The horizon, marked by small structures and trees, is in the far distance. The drawing uses soft pencil strokes and shading to depict trees, buildings, and figures. Three figures are carrying bundles of sticks. More figures and trees can be seen. An old building is at the center right. The color palette is muted browns and grays. The sky has a few small birds.

artworks.title: Riverscape with a Waterfall
artworks.medium: graphite and stumping with scratching-out on white prepared paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 8.1 x 13.5 cm (3 3/16 x 5 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Ivan Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a high horizon showing cloudy skies. There are trees and a distant building along the horizon. The brushstroke technique is detailed, with fine lines defining trees and the landscape's texture. In the foreground, figures are gathered near an old tree. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey. Water flows over rocks below a hill with a tree line. In the distance, subtle architectural structures are visible under a soft sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with Peasants before an Inn
artworks.medium: graphite and stumping with scratching-out on white prepared paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 8.1 x 13.5 cm (3 3/16 x 5 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Ivan Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a pastoral scene. The composition includes a man walking with an ox under trees on the left. In the center, there is a path leading to figures near a rocky, vegetated wall with windows. The drawing features detailed trees, crosshatched strokes for foliage, and a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Saint Gaetano of Thiene
artworks.medium: etching touched with pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure seated on a cloud, looking upwards. He has short hair, a beard, and wears flowing robes. A halo surrounds his head. Below him are a child and a smaller figure, possibly an angel. Above are cherub-like figures in the clouds. In the background, there is an elaborate building with human figures near it, seemingly under construction or renovation.

artworks.title: Bismarckfeier (Celebration for Bismarck)
artworks.medium: hand-colored transfer lithograph on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth and Joseph Bromberg in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level perspective looking towards a large domed building surrounded by a crowd. The horizon line is obscured by the building itself. The top of the dome is highlighted with subtle yellow and flanked by two flag poles with red, yellow, and black flags. The style features loose, sketch-like brushstrokes with a combination of line drawing and watercolor washes. The color palette is light with soft blues in the sky, warm yellows on the dome, and contrasting reds and blacks in the flags. Hints of pale browns and grays illustrate movement and a gathering close to us.

artworks.title: Point Lobos, California
artworks.medium: pen and black and green ink, watercolor, pastel, and graphite on light brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jill Newhouse in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky coastal outcrop with windswept trees on top. The viewpoint is elevated, capturing the rugged landscape. The horizon is suggested by distant hills or mountainous formations toward the upper right, blending into the sky. The style features expressive brushstrokes showcasing rock textures and tree twists. The color palette includes earthy tones like brown, blue, and green, contrasting with the light color of the paper representing the sea and sky.

artworks.title: Dance in a Village Square
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. Several individuals are shown engaged in various activities. Two figures appear to be conversing, while others are dressed elegantly and participating in dance or socializing. In the foreground, two figures are playing instruments, one likely a guitar. The background includes architectural elements like a building with an overhang and a sign with text. The image conveys movement and social interaction, with shading and details characteristic of a period drawing.

artworks.title: Dance in a Palace
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite and squared in graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing showing multiple full-body figures engaged in various activities. Central in the foreground, two figures, a man and a woman, appear to be interacting closely; the man is standing with one hand on his hip, wearing historical attire with breeches and a vest, while the woman beside him is in a dress with embellishments. To the left, three figures are seated around a table; an adult appears to be caring for a child, with the other adult figure draped in fabric. On the right, a group of figures is depicted ascending or descending a staircase, dressed in historical attire. The setting indicates an ornate interior space, possibly a grand hall, with large architectural features like columns and draped curtains adding depth and texture to the composition. The background is filled with architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Tale of the Cooper's Wife
artworks.medium: black, white, and red chalks with stumping on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with a large barrel. The drawing illustrates an indoor setting featuring a large barrel, with other objects like a woven basket on the wall and an overturned stool or similar structure on the floor. The area has a rustic ambiance. The use of graphite or charcoal gives it a soft, textured quality, and highlights a monochromatic palette, with emphasis on texture and form.

artworks.title: Olindo and Sophronia Saved by Clorinda
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene in a historical European city focused on a statue. The scene includes numerous figures and animals, with an atmosphere suggesting a busy market or public gathering with a statue of a poised, draped figure standing on a pedestal. There are horses with riders, with some in historical attire. A domed structure with detailed architecture lies in the background, adding an element of grandeur with tall spires in the distance. Many figures are engaged in activities like observing the statue, talking, or moving through the plaza. The sky is painted with subtle hues, and the color palette consists of earth tones, blues, and grays, lending an antiquated feel to the illustration.

artworks.title: Oriental Woman with a Waterpipe
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Christian Humann Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in a garden setting. One person, a woman with dark hair and a colorful scarf, is sitting on a curved sofa holding a hookah hose. She wears a pink dress and earrings. The other person, a man in a red fez hat and white and blue clothing, is standing next to her holding the hookah. A small table with cups is beside the sofa. The background shows lush greenery with trees and a white stone column.
